_comment: E50a: the historical dated identities music21 wrote, which a learner's stored run, encounter, pruned run's summary or project may name. convert.former_identities re-proves an entry against the undated file the converter writes now (putting the entry's date back gives the entry's bytes) and the build records the proved ones as provenance.formerIdentities. Historical compatibility data, not a rolling window: generated by docs/prompts/runs/E50a/scripts-former-identities.py, never edited by hand; a dated identity found outside it (--check) is added deliberately with --add.

bounds.lower: D4 (9193261b, 2026-09-28): the first catalogue carrying provenance.identity and the first app storing a material on a run; no learner row written before it names a file identity. The converter epoch it was built under (392890bc, 2026-09-16, the last change of convert.py, abc_tools.py and the music21 pin, which the tool fingerprint keys the cache on) dates every build-converted file such a catalogue can hold on or after 2026-09-16; the committed PDMX copies it serves keep their own quarry dates, from 2026-09-06.
bounds.upper: the laptop's deployable catalogues before E50a: the main checkout's app/public/content and app/dist/content (D25: the phone installs what the laptop serves), both written 2026-09-29 22:28 and identical; the latest dated identity in them is the upper bound, never a future date.
